task_description: Search a directory for files whose content matches a pattern.
Encrypt a file with gpg for a recipient.
Run a traceroute to a target address.
Install a package by name with the package manager.
List the running processes whose name contains a search term.
Show the certificate of a remote HTTPS host with openssl.
Run one of the maintenance jobs: backup, cleanup or reindex.
Switch the power profile to one of: performance, balanced, saver.
Validate that a host name has a legal format.
Return the logged-in sessions of a given user name.
